parameters.query:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT $1::TEXT clinic_name,$2::TEXT question,$3::TEXT normalized_query,
         $4::TEXT specialty,NULLIF($5::TEXT,'') service_name,$6::JSONB keywords,
         $7::INTEGER top_k,$8::NUMERIC min_score,NULLIF($9::BIGINT,0) session_id,
         NULLIF($10::BIGINT,0) message_id,NULLIF($11::BIGINT,0) clinical_intake_case_id
),
c AS (
  SELECT clinics.id clinic_id,clinics.name,r.*
  FROM clinics,r WHERE clinics.name=r.clinic_name AND clinics.is_active=TRUE LIMIT 1
),
s AS (
  SELECT services.id service_id,services.name
  FROM services,c WHERE services.clinic_id=c.clinic_id
    AND LOWER(services.name)=LOWER(c.service_name)
    AND c.service_name IS NOT NULL AND services.is_active=TRUE LIMIT 1
),
kw AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(STRING_AGG(value,' '),'') keyword_text
  FROM c LEFT JOIN LATERAL JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(c.keywords) value ON TRUE
),
sc AS (
  SELECT c.*,TRIM(c.normalized_query||' '||(SELECT keyword_text FROM kw)) expanded_query,
         WEBSEARCH_TO_TSQUERY('simple',TRIM(c.normalized_query||' '||(SELECT keyword_text FROM kw))) ts_query
  FROM c
),
qa AS (
  SELECT 'qa'::TEXT result_type,q.id result_id,q.document_id,q.question title,
         NULL::INTEGER page_start,NULL::INTEGER page_end,q.answer content,
         q.requires_human_confirmation,q.safety_category,q.source_priority,
         GREATEST(
           SIMILARITY(LOWER(q.question),LOWER(sc.normalized_query)),
           SIMILARITY(LOWER(q.question||' '||q.question_variants::TEXT||' '||q.keywords::TEXT),LOWER(sc.expanded_query))
         )*0.75+(q.source_priority::NUMERIC/100)*0.25 score
  FROM clinic_knowledge_qa q JOIN sc ON sc.clinic_id=q.clinic_id
  WHERE q.status='published'
    AND (q.valid_from IS NULL OR q.valid_from<=CURRENT_DATE)
    AND (q.valid_to IS NULL OR q.valid_to>=CURRENT_DATE)
    AND (sc.specialty IN ('','all','general') OR LOWER(q.specialty) IN ('general',LOWER(sc.specialty)))
    AND (sc.service_name IS NULL OR q.service_id IS NULL OR q.service_id=(SELECT service_id FROM s))
),
chunks AS (
  SELECT 'chunk'::TEXT result_type,k.id result_id,d.id document_id,
         COALESCE(k.section_title,d.title) title,k.page_start,k.page_end,k.content,
         FALSE requires_human_confirmation,'general'::TEXT safety_category,d.source_priority,
         GREATEST(
           TS_RANK_CD(k.search_vector,sc.ts_query),
           SIMILARITY(LOWER(k.content),LOWER(sc.expanded_query))*0.65
         )+(d.source_priority::NUMERIC/100)*0.20 score
  FROM clinic_knowledge_chunks k
  JOIN clinic_knowledge_documents d ON d.id=k.document_id
  JOIN sc ON sc.clinic_id=d.clinic_id
  WHERE d.status='published' AND d.allowed_use<>'internal_only'
    AND (d.valid_from IS NULL OR d.valid_from<=CURRENT_DATE)
    AND (d.valid_to IS NULL OR d.valid_to>=CURRENT_DATE)
    AND (sc.specialty IN ('','all','general') OR LOWER(d.specialty) IN ('general',LOWER(sc.specialty)))
    AND (sc.service_name IS NULL OR d.service_id IS NULL OR d.service_id=(SELECT service_id FROM s))
    AND (k.search_vector@@sc.ts_query OR SIMILARITY(LOWER(k.content),LOWER(sc.expanded_query))>=sc.min_score)
),
all_candidates AS (
  SELECT * FROM qa UNION ALL SELECT * FROM chunks
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT a.*
  FROM all_candidates a CROSS JOIN sc
  WHERE a.score>=sc.min_score
  ORDER BY a.score DESC,a.source_priority DESC,a.result_id
  LIMIT (SELECT top_k FROM sc)
),
logged AS (
  INSERT INTO clinical_knowledge_queries (
    clinic_id,patient_id,session_id,input_message_id,clinical_intake_case_id,
    question,normalized_query,specialty,service_id,retrieved_chunk_ids,
    retrieved_qa_ids,answer_status
  )
  SELECT sc.clinic_id,cs.patient_id,sc.session_id,sc.message_id,sc.clinical_intake_case_id,
         sc.question,sc.normalized_query,sc.specialty,(SELECT service_id FROM s),
         COALESCE((SELECT JSONB_AGG(result_id) FROM ranked WHERE result_type='chunk'),'[]'::JSONB),
         COALESCE((SELECT JSONB_AGG(result_id) FROM ranked WHERE result_type='qa'),'[]'::JSONB),
         CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ranked) THEN 'retrieved' ELSE 'no_reliable_answer' END
  FROM sc LEFT JOIN conversation_sessions cs ON cs.id=sc.session_id
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c) THEN FALSE
    WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c WHERE service_name IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM s) THEN FALSE
    ELSE TRUE
  END success,
  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c) THEN 'clinic_not_found'
    WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c WHERE service_name IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM s) THEN 'service_not_found'
    WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ranked) THEN 'clinical_knowledge_retrieved'
    ELSE 'no_reliable_clinical_knowledge_found'
  END result,
  (SELECT id FROM logged) clinical_knowledge_query_id,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT JSONB_AGG(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      'result_type',result_type,'result_id',result_id,'document_id',document_id,
      'title',title,'page_start',page_start,'page_end',page_end,'content',content,
      'score',ROUND(score::NUMERIC,5),'requires_human_confirmation',requires_human_confirmation,
      'safety_category',safety_category,'source_priority',source_priority
    ) ORDER BY score DESC,source_priority DESC)
    FROM ranked
  ),'[]'::JSONB) retrieved_context,
  COALESCE((SELECT MAX(score) FROM ranked),0) top_score,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ranked) THEN 'compose_grounded_answer' ELSE 'human_review_or_no_answer' END next_action
FROM r;
